about.title: About Athar Accounting
about.text: Athar Accounting is a cloud accounting system built specifically for the Saudi business environment, aimed at simplifying day-to-day accounting work for business owners and accountants alike. The system is designed to cover the full workflow of any business or group of companies: from the accounting foundation (chart of accounts and daily journal entries), through sales, purchases, inventory and fixed assets, to managing employees, their payroll and entitlements. All of this with full compliance with the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority's e-invoicing requirements, and accurate financial reports that reflect the true picture of business performance at any moment.

why.title: Designed to fit the way you work

items.title: ZATCA compliant
items.desc: Electronic tax invoices (standard and simplified) with a real QR code, built from the ground up to meet the requirements of the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority.

items.title: A whole group in one place
items.desc: Manage all your companies from a single screen, with complete data separation per company and consolidated reports for the whole group.

items.title: A complete employee lifecycle
items.desc: From hiring and leave to payroll and end-of-service benefits, calculated according to Saudi labor law.

items.title: Instant financial reports
items.desc: The trial balance, income statement and balance sheet update live with every entry and invoice you record.

items.title: Integrated sales and purchases cycle
items.desc: From quotation to invoice to receipt, and from purchase order to supplier invoice, with full automatic accounting links.

items.title: An interface designed for your market
items.desc: Built from scratch to fit how accountants in the Saudi market actually work, not an interface translated from a foreign system.

payrollSettings.standardTitle: Standard hours and days per month
payrollSettings.standardNote: Used to convert any component based on "hourly/daily rate" (like overtime or an absence deduction) into a monthly amount.
payrollSettings.noComponentsWarning: No custom components for this company yet — payroll currently runs on the twelve default components (basic, allowances, insurance...) automatically with no setup. ⚠️ Important notice: the first real component you create here switches this company's payroll entirely to relying on saved components only — meaning the old twelve components (including basic and allowances) stop being calculated immediately unless recreated here manually with the same values. Do not add any component manually before running the migration script (backfillPayrollComponents.ts --commit), which creates all twelve components at once with the current values — check with the technical team first.
payrollSettings.formulaTitle: Formula components — Total = Σ (quantity × reference, with optional hour/day conversion)
payrollSettings.formulaExampleNote: Example "overtime" = (1 × total hourly rate) + (0.5 × basic hourly rate): two terms with unit "hour", the first with quantity 1 referencing "Total", the second with quantity 0.5 referencing "Basic".
payrollSettings.adjustmentToggle: Accepts a monthly adjustment as a number of units (e.g. "3 absence days") instead of a ready amount
payrollSettings.allowsMonthlyAdjustments: Appears in the monthly "Employee actions" list
payrollSettings.prorateOnPartialMonth: Prorated when returning after a mid-month leave
payrollSettings.appliesByDefault: Automatically assigned to every new employee
payrollSettings.errNameAccountRequired: Component name and linked account are required
payrollSettings.payslipColumnsNote: Choose here which components appear as columns in the payroll screen and printout, with whatever label and order you want. The "Net" column always appears last.
